title: How to let Spark output print on separate new lines?
question:
Currently my spark console prints like this, which is not very readable:

I want it to print each StructField item on a new line, so that it's easier to read. What should I do? Thanks.

Update: I'm actually following this tutorial (http://www.nodalpoint.com/spark-data-frames-from-csv-files-handling-headers-column-types/), the author is able to print line by line without pprint. I wonder how he/she did that.
answer:
You can always use pprint like this:

import pprint
pprint(fields)

but if you're trying to print schema it is better to use DataFrame.printSchema.
